purpose: Dedicated finance, operations and guest reviews toolbar icons

prompts.finances: Use case: stylized-concept. Create ONE professional hand-painted raster UI icon for FINANCES in original cozy hotel tycoon Hotel Empire. A compact upright jade green leather account ledger, warm ivory page edge visible, one broad brass binding strip and a small stack of THREE oversized brass coins overlapping its lower right. Book and coins form one cohesive bold silhouette, book upright rather than lying flat. Soft modeled rich leather and brushed brass painted materials with warm upper-left light, original cozy game art consistent with ivory/oak/jade/brass palette. Square canvas, entire object centered fits 80% width and height, at least 8% fully transparent padding each edge. True transparent RGBA background. No readable text, writing, labels, digits, currency symbols, decorative logo, watermark, human, UI frame/badge, scene, ground or external cast shadow. No small particles, glitter or tiny ornament. Not SVG, vector, flat clipart, pixel art or photo. Clear even at 28px toolbar size. ONE icon only.
